test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many years will it take for an amount of Rs. 400 to yield Rs. 450 as interest at 5% per annum on simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 400

Interest = Rs. 450

Rate = 5%

**Formula used:**

Time = (Interest × 100)/(Amount × Rate)

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

Time = (Interest × 100)/(Amount × Rate)

⇒ (450 × 100)/(400 × 5)

⇒ (90/4)

⇒ 22.5 years

**∴ The required time is 22.5.**
